final_answer.key_evidence_summary: Pods listing shows the only outlier: ts-assurance-service-f84b798d-h2tkp is 0/1 with STATUS=CreateContainerConfigError on worker-01, while all other 47 pods in train-ticket are Running/Ready. The alert corroborates: ts-assurance-service GET /api/v1/assuranceservice/assurances/types returns HTTP 503 (85 occurrences). DescribeResource on the pod gives the break point: kubelet 'Warning Failed (x12): Error: secret "ts-assurance-mysql" not found', container State Waiting/Reason CreateContainerConfigError; the app YAML shows Deployment ts-assurance-service references it via envFrom.secretRef with Optional: false, so the container config can never be generated. The secrets listing closes the loop: 31 ts-*-mysql Secrets exist (ts-auth-mysql ... ts-wait-order-mysql) but ts-assurance-mysql is absent. CheckServiceConnectivity to ts-assurance-service:18888 fails from worker-01/02/03 (Connection Failed) because the Service selector app=ts-assurance-service has no Ready endpoint, producing the reported partial unreachability.
